starburst:position-deletes:v2.notes: Starburst reads and writes position delete files for row-level DELETE, UPDATE, and MERGE operations when configured for merge-on-read mode

starburst:position-deletes:v3.notes: Starburst reads legacy position delete files on V3 tables and generates deletion vectors or positional delete files depending on configuration

starburst:equality-deletes:v2.notes: Not supported as a write operation. Starburst never produces equality delete files for DELETE/MERGE, writing positional deletes instead. Starburst fully supports reading equality delete files written by other engines (such as Apache Flink) at query time
caveats: Write capability only: Starburst does not produce equality delete files, but can read them

starburst:equality-deletes:v3.notes: Equality deletes are replaced by deletion vectors in Iceberg V3; Starburst does not write equality deletes

starburst:merge-on-read:v2.notes: Starburst supports merge-on-read for DELETE, UPDATE, and MERGE, creating position delete files at write time and merging them on read

starburst:merge-on-read:v3.notes: Starburst supports merge-on-read on V3 tables using Puffin deletion vectors

starburst:copy-on-write:v2.notes: Copy-on-write supported for Iceberg v2 tables.

starburst:copy-on-write:v3.notes: Copy-on-write supported for Iceberg v3 tables.

starburst:schema-evolution:v2.notes: Full schema evolution support via SQL: ADD COLUMN, DROP COLUMN, RENAME COLUMN, and altering column types without rewriting existing data files

starburst:schema-evolution:v3.notes: Full schema evolution supported on V3 tables

starburst:type-promotion:v2.notes: Starburst supports Iceberg type widening via ALTER TABLE ... ALTER COLUMN ... SET DATA TYPE (e.g., INT to BIGINT, FLOAT to DOUBLE, DECIMAL precision widening)

starburst:type-promotion:v3.notes: Type promotion and widening supported on V3 tables

starburst:column-default-values:v2.notes: Column default values are an Iceberg V3 metadata feature; not supported in format version 2

starburst:column-default-values:v3.notes: Column default values supported for Iceberg V3 tables

starburst:table-creation:v2.notes: Full DDL support: CREATE TABLE, CREATE TABLE AS SELECT (CTAS), with table properties for format_version, partitioning, location, and format (Parquet, ORC, Avro)

starburst:table-creation:v3.notes: Supported via CREATE TABLE with format_version = 3

starburst:hidden-partitioning:v2.notes: Full support for Iceberg partition transforms (year, month, day, hour, bucket, truncate) specified via the partitioning table property (e.g., partitioning = ARRAY['year(order_date)', 'bucket(account_id, 16)']); transparent partition pruning at query time

starburst:hidden-partitioning:v3.notes: Hidden partitioning with single-source transforms supported on V3 tables

starburst:partition-evolution:v2.notes: Partition spec evolution supported via ALTER TABLE ... SET PROPERTIES partitioning = ARRAY[...] without rewriting existing data; Starburst queries prune partitions correctly across spec transitions

starburst:partition-evolution:v3.notes: Partition evolution supported on V3 tables

starburst:multi-arg-transforms:v2.notes: Multi-argument transforms are a V3 feature; not applicable to V2

starburst:multi-arg-transforms:v3.notes: Starburst's partitioning table property only supports single-column transforms (bucket, truncate, year, month, day, hour); multi-argument partition transforms cannot be declared in Starburst DDL
caveats: Cannot be declared in Starburst DDL; read path untested

starburst:time-travel:v2.notes: Full SQL time-travel support via FOR TIMESTAMP AS OF and FOR VERSION AS OF clauses

starburst:time-travel:v3.notes: Full time-travel support on V3 tables via FOR TIMESTAMP AS OF and FOR VERSION AS OF

starburst:table-maintenance:v2.notes: Comprehensive table maintenance procedures: ALTER TABLE ... EXECUTE optimize for file compaction, system.expire_snapshots for snapshot cleanup, and system.remove_orphan_files for deleting unreferenced files

starburst:table-maintenance:v3.notes: Table maintenance procedures (compaction, snapshot expiration, orphan file removal) operate on V3 tables

starburst:branching-tagging:v2.notes: Starburst supports Branch and Tag management

starburst:branching-tagging:v3.notes: Starburst supports Branch and Tag management

starburst:read-support:v2.notes: High-performance vectorized read support across Parquet, ORC, and Avro data files with column projection, dynamic partition pruning, and predicate pushdown

starburst:read-support:v3.notes: Full read support for Iceberg V3 tables including deletion vector resolution

starburst:write-insert:v2.notes: Full support for INSERT INTO and CTAS append and overwrite operations into Iceberg tables

starburst:write-insert:v3.notes: Full write support for V3 tables

starburst:write-merge-update-delete:v2.notes: Full row-level mutation support via SQL MERGE INTO, UPDATE, and DELETE statements supporting both copy-on-write and merge-on-read modes

starburst:write-merge-update-delete:v3.notes: Row-level mutations supported on V3 tables using deletion vectors

starburst:catalog-integration:v2.notes: Extensive native catalog integrations including Iceberg REST catalog (Polaris, Unity, Lakekeeper), AWS Glue, Hive Metastore, Nessie, and JDBC catalogs

starburst:catalog-integration:v3.notes: Catalog integrations work with V3 tables where the catalog supports Iceberg format version 3

starburst:statistics:v2.notes: Starburst reads and collects Iceberg column metrics (null counts, min/max values, NaN counts) from manifest files and Puffin files for cost-based optimization and scan pruning

starburst:statistics:v3.notes: Column statistics and Puffin metrics supported for V3 tables

starburst:bloom-filters:v2.notes: Starburst supports file-level bloom filter generation and evaluation for Parquet/ORC format via table properties, and consumes statistics from Puffin files

starburst:bloom-filters:v3.notes: Starburst supports file-level bloom filter generation and evaluation for Parquet/ORC format via table properties, and consumes statistics from Puffin files

starburst:aws-glue-catalog:v2.notes: Native first-class AWS Glue Data Catalog integration configured via iceberg.catalog.type=glue with IAM role authentication and credential management

starburst:aws-glue-catalog:v3.notes: AWS Glue catalog integration supports V3 tables when enabled in catalog settings

starburst:rest-catalog:v2.notes: First-class native Iceberg REST Catalog support configured via iceberg.catalog.type=rest with OAuth2 client credentials authentication, bearer tokens, and storage credential vending

starburst:rest-catalog:v3.notes: REST catalog client supports V3 tables and endpoint capabilities as supported by the backing REST catalog server

starburst:unity-catalog:v2.notes: Starburst connects to Unity Catalog for V3 tables through the standard REST catalog protocol
caveats: Access via Iceberg REST endpoint requires Unity Catalog's Iceberg REST compatibility layer

starburst:unity-catalog:v3.notes: Starburst connects to Unity Catalog for V3 tables through the standard REST catalog protocol
caveats: Access via Iceberg REST endpoint requires Unity Catalog's Iceberg REST compatibility layer

starburst:snowflake-horizon-catalog:v2.notes: Starburst connects to Snowflake Horizon Catalog (built on Apache Polaris) via the Iceberg REST Catalog protocol with OAuth2 authentication and credential vending
caveats: Access is via generic Iceberg REST Catalog protocol

starburst:snowflake-horizon-catalog:v3.notes: Starburst connects to Snowflake Horizon Catalog for V3 tables through the generic REST catalog protocol
caveats: Access is via generic Iceberg REST Catalog protocol

starburst:google-lakehouse:v2.notes: Google Lakehouse runtime catalog exposes a standard Iceberg REST catalog endpoint; Starburst connects via the REST catalog client.
caveats: Access is via generic Iceberg REST Catalog protocol

starburst:google-lakehouse:v3.notes: Google Lakehouse runtime catalog exposes a standard Iceberg REST catalog endpoint; Starburst connects via the REST catalog client.
caveats: Access is via generic Iceberg REST Catalog protocol

starburst:variant-type:v2.notes: Variant type is a V3 feature; not applicable to V2

starburst:variant-type:v3.notes: Starburst maps native JSON / semi-structured types to Iceberg V3 binary Variant type, enabling predicate pushdown and efficient storage without schema flattening

starburst:shredded-variant:v2.notes: Shredded Variant is a V3 feature; not applicable to V2

starburst:shredded-variant:v3.notes: While basic Iceberg V3 Variant support is implemented in Starburst, full query optimization and writing of shredded variant sub-columns is still evolving
caveats: Sub-column shredding write optimization is evolving in the Starburst connector

starburst:geometry-type:v2.notes: Geometry type is a V3 feature; not applicable to V2

starburst:geometry-type:v3.notes: Starburst provides first-class geospatial support (GEOMETRY and SPHERICAL_GEOGRAPHY) with spatial functions (ST_*) that map natively to Iceberg V3 Geo/Geometry types

starburst:nanosecond-timestamps:v2.notes: Nanosecond timestamps are a V3 feature; not applicable to V2

starburst:nanosecond-timestamps:v3.notes: Starburst natively supports TIMESTAMP(9) and TIMESTAMP(9) WITH TIME ZONE, mapping directly to Iceberg V3 nanosecond precision timestamp and timestamptz columns

starburst:unknown-type:v2.notes: Unknown type is a V3 feature; not available in format version 2

starburst:unknown-type:v3.notes: Measured against Starburst 482-e: reading a V3 table that has an Iceberg unknown-type column fails with NOT_SUPPORTED ("Cannot convert from Iceberg type 'unknown' (UNKNOWN) to Starburst type"). Starburst cannot declare or query the unknown type
caveats: V3-only feature; Starburst cannot map the Iceberg unknown type

starburst:lineage:v2.notes: Row Lineage is a V3 feature; not applicable to V2

starburst:lineage:v3.notes: Starburst supports Iceberg V3 row lineage metadata tracking for data provenance, auditability, and change tracking

starburst:deletion-vectors:v2.notes: Deletion vectors are a V3 feature; not applicable to Iceberg V2

starburst:deletion-vectors:v3.notes: Starburst supports Iceberg V3 Puffin-format Deletion Vectors for efficient row-level deletion and merge-on-read operations without creating separate positional delete files for every commit
